highlights: OpenAI and Google DeepMind continue to advance frontier models, with OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra significantly reducing costs for agentic workflows and DeepMind's Gemini 4 Carbon specializing in high-stakes cyber defense and coding.

The development of AI agents is accelerating, marked by the release of open-source skill stacks like MiniMax MCode Stack, advanced self-improvement frameworks such as 'The Trinity', and specialized applications in legal and clinical domains.

Efficiency and accessibility remain critical innovation drivers, demonstrated by breakthroughs like FlashMap for LLM decoding speed, LEANN's extreme RAG vector index compression, and new open-source multimodal models from Liquid AI.

agents.title: MiniMax Open-Sources MCode Stack: 15 Agent Skills Its Coding Team Uses Daily
agents.summary: MiniMax has open-sourced MCode Stack, an MIT-licensed repository of 17 practical skills and 5 checklists, enabling developers to build more effective coding agents based on MiniMax's internal best practices.

agents.title: The Trinity: Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
agents.summary: This new framework, The Trinity, enables multimodal agents to self-improve by evolving reusable capability modules and reorganizing tasks based on shared requirements, addressing scaling bottlenecks for complex agentic systems.

agents.title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
agents.summary: CohortFlow introduces a steerable agent for clinical cohort curation that significantly reduces correction latency by 64.8% and model calls by 38.1% through localized semantic updates, maintaining accuracy for evolving eligibility criteria.

models.title: Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini 4 Carbon, Its Top Model for Cyber Defense and Coding
models.summary: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model scoring high on cyber defense and coding benchmarks, accessible to vetted cyber defenders with tiered pricing, offering powerful capabilities for specialized enterprise applications.

models.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Halving GPT-6.1 Sol’s API Price for Agent Work
models.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast computer-use and vision model, drastically reducing API prices to $1/$5 per million tokens, making advanced agent work significantly more cost-efficient and accessible for developers.

models.title: Polymathic AI and Princeton Researchers Release FlashMap, a Flow Map Drafter for 6.14x Faster LLM Decoding
models.summary: FlashMap is a speculative decoding drafter that achieves up to a 6.14x lossless speedup on LLM decoding by drafting 16 tokens jointly in one pass, offering a significant performance boost for builders deploying large language models.

tools.title: Meet LEANN: An Open-Source Vector Index that Shrinks a 60M-Chunk RAG Index from 201 GB to 6 GB
tools.summary: UC Berkeley's LEANN is an open-source vector index that drastically reduces RAG index size from 201 GB to just 6 GB for 60M chunks by pruning graphs and recomputing embeddings, offering massive efficiency gains for memory-constrained RAG deployments.

tools.title: Baidu Open-Sources Unlimited OCR 2 for Hundred-Page Document Parsing
tools.summary: Baidu has open-sourced Unlimited OCR 2, an MIT-licensed 3B OCR model capable of parsing hundred-page documents in a single request with near-flat per-step decoding costs, enabling efficient long-document processing for developers.

tools.title: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications
tools.summary: This report highlights that specializing the vocabulary of small language models (SLMs) can reduce inference costs by up to 77% in real-world applications, providing a crucial optimization strategy for developers to deploy efficient and cost-effective AI systems.

companies.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
companies.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are significantly expanding their partnership, integrating Oracle business applications and AI agents directly into ChatGPT, which will also power new Oracle AI offerings, broadening ChatGPT's enterprise utility.

companies.title: Legora is building the agentic operating system for legal work
companies.summary: Legora is leveraging OpenAI models like ChatGPT and Codex to create an agentic operating system that accelerates legal workflows and contract analysis, freeing lawyers to focus on higher-value tasks and demonstrating AI's impact in specialized domains.

companies.title: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
companies.summary: Retell is utilizing OpenAI models, with GPT-6 Astra topping its voice agent benchmark, to handle 100 million monthly calls, achieving a $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee and showcasing the commercial viability of AI-powered voice solutions.

learning.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
learning.summary: Google has launched its latest AI Quest lesson, 'Polar Peaks,' focused on neuroscience, offering an accessible opportunity for individuals to enhance their AI literacy by exploring how AI can be applied to map the human brain.

learning.title: Counting the Bandages: On measuring the time that AI saves
learning.summary: This paper provides a framework for evaluating AI's impact on time savings, differentiating between stopwatch and ledger views, and offering a critical perspective on how to accurately measure efficiency gains versus potential errors introduced by AI assistance.

learning.title: Why and How to Do Science When AI Is Better at It: A Framework Grounded in Human Understanding and Direction
learning.summary: This paper presents a framework for scientists to navigate the era of advanced AI, emphasizing the indispensable aims of durable human understanding and direction in scientific pursuit, and providing guidance on delegating research tasks to AI while preserving human agency and accountability.
